variables.B: number of graphic blocks that reach Stage 01 (entries in _output/blocks_gemma_100/index.json with block context)
variables.T: number of findings without a normative clause number (clause binding targets)
variables.P: number of norm quotes queued for paragraph verification
variables.K_md: number of absence-guard MD chunks = 1 if md_chars <= 300000 else ceil(md_chars / (130000 * 2.2))
variables.A: 1 if there is at least one unverified absence-claim finding AND the MD file is readable, else 0
variables.F: 1 if norm_checks contains at least one needs_revision entry, else 0
variables.O: 1 if optimization.json has proposals whose norms changed, else 0
variables.N_txt: number of codex text_analysis chunks (1 unless the prompt exceeds CODEX_TEXT_INPUT_BUDGET)
variables.G: number of codex targeted findings passes = 1 (docnorm) + 1 if section in {AR,EOM,SS,KM} + 1 if FINDING_EVIDENCE_OCR_OBSERVER_ENABLED
variables.R: clause-binding rounds, 1..2 (second round only for clause numbers rejected by the norms index)

per_block.degraded: 3 when any leg fails (judge skipped); with STAGE01_ABORT_ON_LEG_FAILURE_ENABLED=true the stage then stops

conditional_calls.count: 0 normally; ceil(P/15) only if verify_paragraphs_native raises

per_block.note: Stage 01 is not affected by the preset switch

retry_multiplier.scope: every codex JSON-mode stage (text_analysis, findings_merge and its targeted passes, norm_verify, optimization_critic)
retry_multiplier.factor: up to AUDIT_CODEX_JSON_ATTEMPTS = 3, triggered only by error_message == 'codex_json_not_found'

preset_codex_exec.total: 4*B + N_txt + 1 + G + 2 + 1 + A*K_md + ceil(T/25)*R + F + O

shared_observations.stage01_dominance: at B=40, Stage 01 is 160 of ~170 calls (94%) in both presets
shared_observations.preset_switch_cost_delta: roughly +1..+4 calls for Full Codex (targeted passes), not a structural change
shared_observations.block_concurrency: AUDIT_STAGE02_CODEX_PARALLELISM=2 -> at most 2 blocks x 3 legs = 6 concurrent inferences from Stage 01
shared_observations.paid_calls: only the openrouter leg of Stage 01 is metered money (B calls); everything else runs on Claude/Codex subscriptions
